conventions: Geometric (standard-DH) base, fixed tool +Z along -base-Z, tool +X along base +X. All branch slots retain their analytic shoulder/wrist/elbow ID along the 11 knots. Joint angles are unwrapped and shifted by a constant 2π multiple per joint to satisfy limits.
selection: Among fixed branches satisfying joint limits, the step limit and the continuous tracking enclosure, minimize max over knots and six joints |q_j(s)-q_j(0)|. Within 1e-6 degrees of the lowest excursion, select the largest minimum knot sigma, then lowest branch ID. This ranking permits near-singular motions; the positive 0.02 whole-edge sigma filter is reported separately.
continuity: The provided piecewise-linear joint curve is continuous and follows the intended Cartesian line within the archived validated tracking bounds. The branch sigma metric shown in the figure is a knot minimum. For each curve a separate conservative whole-edge lower bound with 32 subdivisions per 1 mm edge is stored. No obstacle, cable, time profile or controller model.
case_selection: The same +X path at the same upright Z is reused for all runs. Cases intentionally cover a middle region, within 12 mm of the base axis, shoulder tangency, a radial elbow extension boundary, the origin and a 10 mm line crossing the extension boundary. These are local demonstrations, not extrema over all XYZ and motion directions.
